technical.summary: Strong uptrend structure with golden cross and new highs, but extreme overbought conditions (RSI 87.5, Stoch 93.49) and stochastic bearish cross create pullback risk; suitable for risk-managed entry only.

fundamental.summary: ABBV shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest with earnings in 53 days—insufficient smart money alignment for actionable trade.

sentiment.summary: No congressional conviction signal; market greed at 70 suggests caution; neutral AAII sentiment and absent news data provide insufficient directional conviction for ABBV.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (65.5) indicates extreme market fear, CPI event in 1 day adds near-term volatility; earnings in 53 days provides some buffer but healthcare sector faces structural credit stress in risk-off environment.

debate.key_bull_argument: Golden cross (EMA 20/50), three white soldiers, and 20-day new high establish strong uptrend structure with technical momentum despite overbought readings.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme overbought conditions (RSI 87.5, Stoch 93.49 with bearish cross), zero fundamental conviction, macro crisis (VIX 65.5, inverted yield curve, CPI event in 1 day), and price at 52-week highs create unacceptable risk/reward for swing entry.
